disposition.change: Section 17 guardrail now names the six personal guarantee_claim fields carried as business facts only, per Data Classification v5 DF-TRT-017 to DF-TRT-022.
disposition.note: Source: Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5, rows DF-TRT-017 to DF-TRT-022 (rwb_guarantee: 8 fields, 6 personal). Story lists the six fields and the business-fact rule in section 17.

disposition.change: Section 19 states the window as a GUA rule-row parameter with value Not specified, the default-conditions date as a signal fact, and the preparation as an unattended step with no agent binding.
disposition.note: Window value, state map to LOV-CLAIM-STATUS and event set are in no source; left open. Checklist via client library (ASM-4494) and durable timer (ASM-4492) already in story text.

edits.old: - No personal data in logs, workflow inputs, activity requests, events or tests: the step carries the case ID, the claim ID, dates, amounts and versions only, and the fixture is synthetic.
edits.new: - No personal data in logs, workflow inputs, activity requests, events or tests: the step carries the case ID, the claim ID, dates, amounts and versions only, and the fixture is synthetic. The six fields `claim_type`, `claim_deadline`, `claimed_amount`, `filed_at`, `paid_amount` and `status` of `guarantee_claim` are classed Customer data and personal in Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5 (DF-TRT-017 to DF-TRT-022); the step carries them as business facts only, never beside a direct identifier and never their customer value.

edits.old: - The preparation window as a value and the date the default conditions are met as a field: not fixed by any source; GAP-2708 and ASM-4493 and ASM-4497.
edits.new: - The value of the preparation window, a rule-row parameter of the `GUA` package set by the rule owner, and the date the default conditions are met, a fact of the case signal and not a `guarantee_claim` field: the values are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2708; ASM-4493; ASM-4497).

edits.old: - Any call to the rwb-agent runtime for the "claim preparation agent" of AC2: no source binds the feature to it; ASM-4495.
edits.new: - Any call to the rwb-agent runtime for the "claim preparation agent" of AC2: the preparation is confirmed as one unattended step, so no agent binding is built in this story (ASM-4495).

edits.old: The six fields `claim_type`, `claim_deadline`, `claimed_amount`, `filed_at`, `paid_amount` and `status` of `guarantee_claim` are classed Customer data and personal in Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5 (DF-TRT-017 to DF-TRT-022); the step carries them as business facts only, never beside a direct identifier and never their customer value.
The remaining quota and the remaining days are shown on the claim; the filing stays with RWB-S3-E4014-APP, and the guarantee officer files the claim by hand until INT-29 is available.
edits.new: The filing stays with RWB-S3-E4014-APP, and the guarantee officer files the claim by hand until INT-29 is available.
